lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Saul and Jonathan died in a battle on Mount Gilboa.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: How are the mighty fallen!

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Jonathan, my brother. You were so kind to me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The men of Judah anointed David king at Hebron.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Later, all the tribes of Israel came too.

lines.speaker: elders
lines.text: We are your bone and your flesh. You will lead us.

lines.speaker: guards
lines.text: You'll never get in here!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David took the stronghold of Zion. It became the city of David.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: LORD, shall I go up against them?

lines.speaker: lord
lines.text: When you hear marching in the treetops, then go.

lines.speaker: david-men
lines.text: Not yet!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David danced before the LORD with all his might.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I live in a house of cedar, but God's ark lives in a tent.

lines.speaker: nathan
lines.text: The LORD says: I will build a house for you.

lines.speaker: caption
lines.text: Thy throne shall be established for ever.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Who am I, O Lord GOD, that you have brought me this far?

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Is anyone left from Saul's family? I want to be kind for Jonathan's sake.

lines.speaker: mephibosheth
lines.text: Why would the king be kind to someone like me?

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Don't be afraid. You will always eat at my table.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The shepherd boy became the shepherd of all Israel.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And God kept His promise to David.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: From David's family, God sent a King whose kingdom never ends.

lines.speaker: caption
lines.text: The Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David… and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: The End. Thank you for playing Shepherd King.
